title: ソフトウェア工学Ⅱ
subtitle: Software Engineering II
keywords: Productivity 2.Reliability 3.Confirmation for Information 4.Methodology of Software Development 5.Project
educationalGoal: Software engineering is a technical system for solving various problems in software development and maintenance. It is said that there are four aspects of software development: three Ps and one M, namely, product, process, project, and management. This course gives students the necessary understanding of various problems in these aspects of software development and shows how to solve them.
advice: The course consists of lecture participation and question-answer report submission (shown as "Quizzes" in the "Evaluation Criteria" column). In addition to the question-answer report, a software-development-company report (shown as “Other” in the "Evaluation Criteria" column) is to be submitted weekly. Each lecture must be attended with awareness of the presented problem. In order to ensure it is presented and understood well, a theme will be given in the second half of the lecture, and students will write and submit a composition (question-answer report) corresponding to the theme by the assigned deadline. Students are required to indicate their level of problem awareness in the composition (approximately 500 characters). A revised version of the software-development-company report will be submitted each week. Although the report title will remain the same, its contents are to be updated weekly. Students will attempt to make gradual improvements to its content and quantity. The primary issue of the report is to explain what kind of technology each company uses in order to become the president of a “virtual” software development company. Students will be required to incorporate the contents learned in class into the contents of their report.
books: Textbooks: Software Engineering II (distributed as PDF) [Kanazawa Institute of Technology] Reference books: None Reserved books: None
requiredKnowledge: Students should bring a laptop PC to class. The software-development company reports can be created as either a Word or a PDF file and then uploaded to the University portfolio system. Students should compose a Word file during class [question-answer report]. Students should submit their weekly reports by the predetermined deadlines [Software-Developer-Company Report].

activityGoals.body: Be able to make a proposal contributing to reliability guarantees in software development.
Be able to make a proposal contributing to productivity improvements in software development.
Be able to confirm information correctly and show an understanding of the importance of technology.
Be able to understand and apply technology related to the internal structure of software products.
Be able to understand and apply technologies related to software development processes.
Be able to understand and apply technologies related to software development projects.

achievementLevels.ideal: By the end of the course, students should be able to explain the following: ・What various technologies are included in software products. ・How the software development process should be conducted. ・What a software development organization should be. ・How software development should be managed. ・How software development engineers should be nurtured.
achievementLevels.standard: By the end of the course, students should be able to explain the following: ・What a software product should be. ・Various issues in the software development process. ・Various issues of software development organization. ・Various management issues in software development. ・Problems encountered by software development engineers.

lessons.content: Provide class guidance and understand learning objectives. Understand report issues and how to submit reports. Be able to explain what is software engineering.
lessons.assignments: Understand the learning objectives well. Be able to explain the purpose of software engineering.

lessons.content: Understand that there are four aspects to software development. Think about how software products should be in the first place. Consider what the software development process is.
lessons.assignments: Acquire an overview of software engineering. Software is an information processing system. Consider what a desirable information processing system is.

lessons.content: Think about how software development management should be. Think about what software development organizations and development projects should be. Consider what types of software engineers have and what kind of approach they want.
lessons.assignments: Think about how to manage software in the middle of development, quality control, and project management.

lessons.content: Understand an operating system (OS) and Application Program Interface (API). Understand compiler and linker technologies. Understand control structure and function technology.
lessons.assignments: Understand the basic operating principles of computers. Consider a computer as a “program execution device”. Imagine that both OS and API are programs.

lessons.content: Learn various data structure technologies. Understand the existence of various algorithms. Understand module structure and encapsulation technology.
lessons.assignments: Think about why the technology to regulate the storage area, such as variables, arrays, tree structures, and recursive structures, was created.

lessons.content: Understand the technology of layer structure. Understand the relationship between instances and classes in object orientation. Understand the relationship between object-oriented classes and inheritance.
lessons.assignments: The layer structure is a structure in which modules are divided into hierarchies and given a hierarchical relationship. A structure that can be called from top to bottom, but not vice versa. Think about the benefits.

lessons.content: Consider multiple inheritance techniques and issues. Understand object abstraction, condition abstraction, and behavior abstraction. Consider information hiding and localization techniques.
lessons.assignments: Think about what happens when you have multiple superclasses.

lessons.content: Consider exception handling technology. Understand parallel processing and transaction technology. Think about data independence and database technology.
lessons.assignments: Rules with many exceptions are complex and annoying to both the programmer and the user. Exceptions should be eliminated as much as possible, but exceptions still occur. What should we think about?

lessons.content: Consider design patterns and reusability. Understand a graphical user interface (GUI) and framework technology. Consider the memory leak problem and the storage area technology.
lessons.assignments: A module is a part as a program entity, but a design pattern is a conceptual part. Imagine that there is a pattern in the design.

lessons.content: Follow the history of programming language technology development and think about language and parts collection. Understand how to make secure (safe) programs with antivirus and anti-hacker measures. Consider development technology for embedded software.
lessons.assignments: There are various languages such as C, C++, Java, and C#. Technology improvement and language development are linked. Understand what has changed over time.

lessons.content: The software development process technology is explained. Consider software design technology, implementation technology, review technology, test technology, verification technology, and documentation technology.
lessons.assignments: Consider human factors in software development, the characteristics of knowledge labor, and human resource development. Review of lecture content and review for final exam of achievement confirmation test.

lessons.content: The software development project technology is explained. Think about knowledge labor and human resource development. An achievement confirmation test is given.
lessons.operation: Lectures and Final exam of achievement confirmation test
lessons.assignments: Consider human factors in software development, the characteristics of knowledge labor, and human resource development. Review of lecture content and review for final exam of achievement confirmation test.

lessons.content: Students learn using external materials such as videos, and consider their future approach to software engineering. Students self-evaluate their achievements.
lessons.assignments: Looking back on what has been learned so far. It will lead to future learning and research.
